paite: "Mihing, numei a pan pian nite tomchik ahi a, buaina ngen in adim hi.
english: “Man, who is born of a woman, is of few days, and full of trouble.

paite: Pak bang in ahong dawnkhia a, avuai nawn pah a, limliap bang in atai a, a-om gige kei.
english: He comes forth like a flower, and is cut down. He also flees like a shadow, and doesn’t continue.

paite: Mi huchibang tung ah na mit hak in, vaihawmna ah kei na hon pi dia hia?
english: Do you open your eyes on such a one, and bring me into judgment with you?

paite: Thilnin a kipan kua'n ahia thilsiang lakhe thei? Kuamah in.
english: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? Not one.

paite: Anite sehsa ahi chih thei in, na kiang ah akhate simna a-om a, akan thei louh ding in agamgite na septa hi.
english: Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months is with you, and you have appointed his bounds that he can’t pass;

paite: Amah en ke'n, akhawltheihna ding in, kiloh bang a, ani ahihkim matan.
english: Look away from him, that he may rest, until he shall accomplish, as a hireling, his day.

paite: "Phukpaih in om mahleh, ahong sel nawn ding a, ahiang nou atawp kei ding, chih sing a ding in lametna lah a-om ngal a.
english: “For there is hope for a tree, If it is cut down, that it will sprout again, that the tender branch of it will not cease.

paite: Lei ah azung upa mahleh, akungpi lei ah sita mahleh;
english: Though its root grows old in the earth, and its stock dies in the ground,

paite: Tuigim ziak in ahong nou thak dia, sing suan bang in bawkte ahon neikhe nawn ding hi.
english: yet through the scent of water it will bud, and put forth boughs like a plant.

paite: Mihing asi a, amang zel hi; ahi, mihing in akha akhah a, huan koi ah a-om a?
english: But man dies, and is laid low. Yes, man gives up the spirit, and where is he?

paite: "Tuipi a kipan tuihute alenmang bang in, luipi bel atul a, akang hi.
english: As the waters fail from the sea, and the river wastes and dries up,

paite: Huai mah bang in mihing alum a athou kei hi, vante a-om nawn louh matan, akhanglou kei ding uh, a-ihmu uh leng ahalh khe sam kei ding uhi.
english: so man lies down and doesn’t rise. Until the heavens are no more, they shall not awake, nor be roused out of their sleep.

paite: "Aw Sheol ah hon sel lechin aw, na thangpaihna aman masiah hon na gukkep lechin, hun sehsa hon na pia in, kei hon theigige lechin aw;
english: “Oh that you would hide me in Sheol Sheol is the place of the dead. , that you would keep me secret, until your wrath is past, that you would appoint me a set time, and remember me!

paite: Mi sileh ahing nawn diam? Ka galdouna leh nasepna ni tengteng ka ngak ding a, ka suahtakna ahong tun matan in.
english: If a man dies, shall he live again? All the days of my warfare would I wait, until my release should come.

paite: N'on na sam dia, k'on dawng ding hi, na khut nasep na hon lunggulh ding hi.
english: You would call, and I would answer you. You would have a desire to the work of your hands.

paite: Tu in ka kalsuante na sim a: ka khelhnate na chiamteh hi.
english: But now you number my steps. Don’t you watch over my sin?

paite: Ip sung ah ka tatlekna bilh in ni a-om a, ka thulimlouhna na gonggak hi.
english: My disobedience is sealed up in a bag. You fasten up my iniquity.

paite: "Tang kipuk bangmah lou ahong hi taktak a, amun a kipan in suangpi suan in a-om hi;
english: “But the mountain falling comes to nothing. The rock is removed out of its place;

paite: tuite'n suang akiamsak ua; leivui a kibawl mun sangte na taimang a; huan mihing lametna na hihsia hi.
english: The waters wear the stones. The torrents of it wash away the dust of the earth. So you destroy the hope of man.

paite: Tangtawn in amah na zou a, apai a; amel na lamdangsak a, na sawlmang hi.
english: You forever prevail against him, and he departs. You change his face, and send him away.

paite: Atapate zah in a-om ua, ama'n athei kei; hihniam in a-om ua, himahleh ama'n amau ahi chih athei kei hi.
english: His sons come to honor, and he doesn’t know it. They are brought low, but he doesn’t perceive it of them.

paite: Himahleh atung a sa in natna anei a, asung ah akha in asuun hi."
english: But his flesh on him has pain, and his soul within him mourns.”
